take: verb
move or go with someone, or carry something with you to a place
typical: take + person/thing + to + place. NOT for: bringing something to the speaker (use bring).
Take your umbrella, it might rain.
I'll take you to the airport.
verb
do or have an action expressed by the noun
typical: take a break/look/shower/photo/walk. NOT for: giving.
Let's take a break.
He took a photo of the bridge.
verb
need an amount of time
typical: it takes + time, take + person + time. NOT for: people as subject of duration.
The trip takes two hours.
It took me a week to finish.
verb
accept or choose something offered
typical: take the job/offer/advice. NOT for: receiving unasked.
She took the job in Prague.
I'll take the blue one.
verb
use a vehicle or route
typical: take the bus/train/second left. NOT for: driving the vehicle.
I take the bus to work.
Take the second left after the bank.
